details: Flash floods and debris flows strike after suspected glacier collapse.
Ms 5.2 seismic signal associated with the collapse.
Floodwater destroys the border crossing shortly after the seismic event.
Chinese authorities warn of a barrier lake and possible breach.
One lake overflows slightly; rescue operations briefly paused.
Barrier lake reported largely empty; additional flood warnings issued.
Ministry of Health reported only about 4% of roughly 900 bodies found had been identified.
NDRRMA reported nearly 1.6 million people affected.
